entities.summary: Thomas Warner, a notable figure in the history of Antigua and Barbuda, associated with English Colonization and the Sugar Economy (1632–1674). Preceded by Codrington family acquires land and begins sugar cultivation and Edward Warner establishes English colony on Antigua in 1632. Their legacy influenced Christopher Codrington establishes Betty's Hope plantation 1674 and Sugar Revolution and Plantation System.
